item.title: {risAT}: Climate change in asylum-related decisions of the Austrian Federal Administrative Court (BVwG)
item.dc:creator: Roland Schmidt
item.description: Using {risAT} to search Austrian Federal Administrative Court (BVwG) asylum decisions for references to climate change (Klimawandel).

item.title: Introducing {risAT}: An R package to access with Austria’s Legal Information System (RIS)
item.dc:creator: Roland Schmidt
item.description: {risAT} is an R package that wraps the Austrian RIS (Rechtsinformationssystem) Open Government Data API, making it easier to work with Austrian jurisprudence in R.
